AncRegistration.title: ANC Registration
AncRegistration.description: Represents a participant's registration in the ANC cohort study.

participantId.description: Unique ID for the participant, prefixed by health facility ID.

healthFacility.description: The health facility where registration occurred.

age.description: Age of the participant in years.

phoneNumber.description: A list of the participant's phone numbers.

nextOfKinName.description: Name of the next of kin.

alternativeContact.description: Phone number for the next of kin or alternative contact.

gestationalAge.description: Gestational age in weeks at the time of registration.

firstAncDate.description: Date of the first ANC visit.

registeredBy.description: Name of the clinician or data clerk who performed the registration.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created in the database.

/anc_registrations/{registrationId}.description: Stores all ANC participant registration records. The registrationId is the same as the participantId.
